card.name: Just before stomach and gut words
card.fires_on: Words and word parts right before a stomach or gastrointestinal term, such as the start of Stomach or gastric, or 'the' and 'empty' before stomach. It appears in drug labels and health text.

modes.label: Inside stomach spellings
modes.description: Partway through the word Stomach or Gastrointestinal, just before the rest of the word.

modes.label: Linking word before stomach
modes.description: A small word like the or empty that is followed by a stomach or gastric term.
modes.example: Absorption is probably better on an<< empty>> stomach.

modes.label: Before ulcer or GI terms
modes.description: The start of a word or heading about GI bleeding or peptic ulcer.
modes.example: Patients with a prior history of<< pe>>ptic ulcer disease and/or GI bleeding who

card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name the stomach or digestive tract.
